episodes.synopsis: Ageha doesn't get along with her black cat contractor, Oboro. They fight.
episodes.title: Black Cat Oboro

episodes.synopsis: A spirit is unable to pass on, held back by a desire to play tennis in the school tennis club.
episodes.title: Court of Dreams

episodes.synopsis: Rinne's shinigami union payments go missing. Shirushigami Kain threatens him with late charges.
episodes.title: The Missing Membership Fee

episodes.synopsis: A spirit who passed away in the Showa era returns, causing trouble all around the neighborhood.
episodes.title: Song of Love

episodes.synopsis: Rinne's grandma cleans her house, and digs up some goodies. Rinne's Dad is broke again. A demon tries to take one of Sakura's friends' brothers to Hell.
episodes.title: Digging Up Memories, Can I Borrow Cash?, Demon at the Camp Grounds

episodes.synopsis: Rinne's homestay, Shouma, is quite a handful. Hoping to end his school assignment quickly, he goes after an evil spirit, but the spirit appears elsewhere as a living human being.
episodes.title: Homestay Trainee

episodes.synopsis: Masato tricks Rinne's homestay, Shouma, into turning spirits evil. Both Rinne and Shouma are in deep trouble.
episodes.title: Coaching Responsibilities

episodes.synopsis: A spirit is wandering around the steps of a local shrine. She'd died trying to curse Mamiya and Sakura's homeroom teacher, Suzuki-sensei
episodes.title: The Cursed Straw Doll

episodes.synopsis: Rinne's Shinigami Scythe needs sharpening. He's invited to Mikazukido, a scythe smith that goes back generations -- but they kind of suck.
episodes.title: Mikazukido for All Your Scythe Needs

episodes.synopsis: Rokumon and the other black cats are invited to the celebration of a high-profile black cat before his reincarnation. Meanwhile, Rinne does battle with a hobo moth who threatens to make him even poorer.
episodes.title: Black Cat 6th Dan

episodes.synopsis: It's summer festival season. Rokudou doesn't have money to spend on such fun. Instead, he investigates rumors of "Dancing People."
episodes.title: Monsters of the Summer Festival

episodes.synopsis: Sakura and her friends head to the beach, where they run into Rinne, Ageha, Tsubasa and Rokumon. They investigate a ghost boat, an octopus monster and a section of the beach rumored to be filled with spirits.
episodes.title: Ghost Boat / Something in the Tunnel / Welcome to Nehan-ya

episodes.synopsis: Shima Renge is a new student at school. She has a habit of breaking people's hearts -- possibly on purpose.
episodes.title: The Mysterious Transfer Student

episodes.synopsis: Shima Renge's self-imposed community service work hurts Rinne's weather box business, leaving him terrifyingly poor.
episodes.title: Renge's Revenge

episodes.synopsis: Mikazukido's Recovery Cream can fix anything -- including cats. There's a spirit in the staff storage at school. The black cats go on a trip hunting for magic mushrooms.
episodes.title: Recovery Cream / Rumors / Mushroom Hunting

episodes.synopsis: Ageha tries to break-up Rinne and Sakura with an arsenal of Shinigami tools. Renge gets involved, in an attempt to have it all blow up in Ageha's face.
episodes.title: Break-up Kit

episodes.synopsis: Demon Masato gets involved his wings stolen by a mysterious man who seems to be trying to lure Rinne into the Shinigami Elementary School reunion.
episodes.title: Shinigami Elementary School Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Rokumon enters the Black Cat Ranking Exam in pursuit of a ranked black cat contractor discount. Kain and Ageha also have their black cat contractors join. Calamity ensues.
episodes.title: Black Cat Ranking Exam

episodes.synopsis: Rokumon's plan to get the key to the Shinigami door backfires, but he gets his reward. The exam heats up even more.
episodes.title: MVC

episodes.synopsis: Rokumon's plan to get the key to the Shinigami door backfires, but he gets his reward. The exam heats up even more.
episodes.title: Hot Pot Boss, Demon Type-A, Shinigami Type-B

episodes.synopsis: A bossy evil spirit and a bossy Tsubasa nearly crash an oden party Ageha sets up for Rinne. Masato and Rinne are both sick with afterworld strains of influenza. They engage in a glorious coughing battle.
episodes.title: Have My Scarf, Waiting on the Rink

episodes.synopsis: Renge does everything in her power -- and then some -- to stop her crush, Shirushigami Kain, from finding out that she's a Damashigami.
episodes.title: Never Change...

episodes.synopsis: Sakura picks up a scythe that becomes attached to her until she can successfully purify seven spirits.
episodes.title: Shinigami Sakura?!

episodes.synopsis: Ageha tries to put Rinne on a collar. Rinne's friend from elementary school, Matsugo, is not amused. Sakura, on the other hand, sees an opportunity.
episodes.title: Matsugo Returns?!

episodes.synopsis: At their faux date, Sakura overhears Rinne saying he likes her because she feeds him and lends him money. He tries to clear things up with her, but Matsugo has his own ideas.
episodes.title: Sakura's Wager
